digest.component_or_area: rebar MCP HTTP transport on AWS box (compose + Dockerfile + nginx routing)
propositions: A new mcp compose service built from Dockerfile.mcp publishes rebar-mcp HTTP on loopback 127.0.0.1:8091 with restart always and a healthcheck endpoint, configured fail-closed via environment variables for transport, auth, and TLS-at-edge acknowledgment

An nginx /mcp/ location proxies to a named upstream rebar_mcp whose server line is materialized from an include glob mcp-upstream*.conf, with a committed seed file and an installer script that populates it only-if-absent before docker compose up

A /health endpoint on the MCP server returns JSON with an integer in_flight gauge counting only certified ops (review_plan/verify_completion/review_code/scan_spec), is exempt from authentication, and returns 200 without a bearer token even when REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=1

SIGTERM grace on the MCP process waits up to 1200s (DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS) for in_flight to drain to 0 before exiting, with compose stop_grace_period set to 1260s to prevent Docker SIGKILL during an in-flight operation
Fail-closed bootstrap: non-loopback bind without TLS-at-edge/allowlist acknowledgment raises McpStartupError; with the ack the server boots successfully

The blue-green cutover is supported by foxterrier atomically rewriting the mcp-upstream.conf server line and reloading nginx to re-point traffic, with foxterrier retirement logic checking the in_flight gauge before draining a container
